notes: One marker per metro or hub town per operator, drawn mainly from the DroneXL and Drone Authority trackers and operator pages. Most coordinates are town centres, not launch pads. Services that ended or paused are left off: DroneUp, Wing Australia, Manna Ireland, and four suspended Zipline hubs in Ghana and Nigeria. The FAA had not finalised its Part 108 long-range rule as of this snapshot.

ARE.summary: Dubai's civil aviation authority licenses commercial BVLOS delivery; Keeta Drone flies food orders in two districts.

ARG.summary: ANAC has sanctioned only trial cargo drone flights, begun in 2025 by DronesVIP with Speedbird Aero.

AUS.summary: CASA approves BVLOS operators case by case and runs a broad-area BVLOS trial; Wing ended its delivery service in January 2026.

BEL.summary: Trials only: BVLOS medical flights between the AZ Turnhout hospital campuses started in August 2025 under the BURDI project.

BRA.summary: ANAC approved routine BVLOS flights over dense urban areas in March 2026; Speedbird Aero flies iFood orders in two cities.

CAN.summary: Transport Canada rules in force since 4 November 2025 allow lower-risk BVLOS without a special certificate; delivery routes remain few.

CHE.summary: Switzerland applies the EU drone rules; FOCA has approved specific medical lab routes such as Jedsy's from Buchs.

CHN.summary: A revised Civil Aviation Law regulates drones nationally, and Meituan, JD and others run routine urban delivery routes.

CIV.summary: Zipline delivers medical supplies from Daloa; the government approved an eight-year plan to grow from one hub to ten.

COL.summary: Aerocivil approved a first Colombian company for drone deliveries in 2025; no routine public service is confirmed.

DEU.summary: EU drone rules apply; regulators approved a first permanent scheduled delivery drone line in Lüdenscheid in February 2024.

ESP.summary: EU drone rules apply; AESA issued Spain's first SAIL III authorisation for cargo drones over populated areas in June 2026.

FIN.summary: EU drone rules apply; Manna flies Wolt food orders by drone in Espoo with final permits from the authorities.

FRA.summary: EU drone rules apply; La Poste runs a few DGAC-authorised parcel drone lines, the third opened in the Vercors in 2024.

GBR.summary: No general BVLOS rule; the CAA approves case by case. Routine NHS sample flights run in London while Amazon flies a capped trial.

GHA.summary: Zipline flies medical supplies under a state contract; three of six hubs are suspended over unpaid government bills.

HKG.summary: Drone delivery runs only as pilot projects under the government's Low-altitude Economy Regulatory Sandbox.

IDN.summary: Trials only: Grab and SKYY Network run a BVLOS food delivery pilot in Bali.

IND.summary: BVLOS delivery is approved operator by operator under the Drone Rules 2021; Skye Air and India Post run routine flights.

IRL.summary: EU drone rules apply and a 2025 national framework exists, but Manna paused the only delivery service in June 2026.

ISR.summary: Deliveries fly only inside the state-run National Drone Initiative, which is moving from tests to simulated commercial operations.

ITA.summary: EU drone rules apply; ENAC authorises BVLOS medical flights project by project, such as the Niguarda hospital trial in Milan.

JPN.summary: Level 4 flight, BVLOS over people, has been legal since December 2022; deliveries so far are demonstrations.

KEN.summary: Zipline delivers medical supplies from Chemelil in Kisumu County with approvals from the KCAA and defence ministry.

KOR.summary: The state-backed K-Drone Delivery programme serves islands and parks, with 23 local governments taking part.

MEX.summary: NOM-107 covers drones in general, but BVLOS requirements are still being drafted and no delivery service runs.

MWI.summary: Malawi granted Wingcopter a nationwide flight permit for medical deliveries first run in Kasungu district.

MYS.summary: Trials only; the government roadmap expects freight drone operations from the first quarter of 2027.

NGA.summary: Zipline delivers medical supplies in Kaduna, Cross River and Bayelsa states and plans 12 more hubs by 2028.

NLD.summary: Trials only: the medical drone pilot between the Isala hospitals in Meppel and Zwolle is extended to mid-2027.

NOR.summary: EU drone rules apply via the EEA; Aviant launched its Kyte home delivery service for remote areas in 2023.

NZL.summary: Operators need CAA Part 102 certification; SkyDrop was approved for regular drone deliveries in 2023.

RWA.summary: Zipline has delivered medical supplies nationwide since 2016; a 2026 agreement adds urban delivery and a third hub.

SAU.summary: GACA issued its first drone delivery permit in May 2026, limited to medicines at the Hajj holy sites in Makkah.

SGP.summary: BVLOS flights need case-by-case permits; drones are being trialled for ship-to-shore deliveries at the port.

SWE.summary: EU drone rules apply; foodora, Tele2 and Aviant began a drone food delivery rollout on Värmdö near Stockholm in 2025.

THA.summary: Trials only: the aviation regulator announced delivery drone trials for Bangkok in 2025.

US-AR.summary: Zipline flies Walmart orders from Pea Ridge to 12 communities in Northwest Arkansas and Missouri.

US-AZ.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Tolleson in the Phoenix area; Wing and Zipline have announced Phoenix.

US-FL.summary: Wing flies Walmart orders in Greater Orlando and Amazon Prime Air flies from Ruskin near Tampa.

US-GA.summary: Wing flies Walmart orders in Metro Atlanta; Amazon Prime Air has announced Atlanta.

US-ID.summary: Amazon Prime Air began flying from Nampa, near Boise, on 30 October 2026.

US-IL.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Markham in Chicago's south suburbs.

US-KS.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Kansas City, Kansas.

US-LA.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Baton Rouge; Wing has announced New Orleans.

US-MI.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Hazel Park and Pontiac in the Detroit area.

US-NC.summary: Wing flies Walmart and DoorDash orders in the Charlotte area, including a Lowe's pilot in Matthews.

US-NE.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from Papillion in the Omaha area.

US-OH.summary: Amazon Prime Air flies from North Randall and Zipline delivers Cleveland Clinic prescriptions from Beachwood.

US-OK.summary: Manna launched its first full-scale US metro operation in Tulsa in July 2026.

US-TN.summary: Wing began Walmart drone delivery in the Memphis area on 10 November 2026.

US-TX.summary: Wing, Zipline, Amazon Prime Air, Flytrex and Manna all fly in Dallas-Fort Worth; Wing, Zipline and Amazon also serve Houston.

US-VA.summary: Wing has flown from Christiansburg since 2019; DoorDash lists drone checkout in Southwest Virginia.

USA.summary: Federal law. Carriers fly BVLOS delivery under FAA Part 135 and exemptions; the Part 108 BVLOS rule is still in White House review, not final.

ZAF.summary: Routine BVLOS flight is not generally permitted yet; the SACAA is still working on a framework.
